{{Top|leg}}
The '''Praji Estate''' was an estate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], that was owned by the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]].

==Description==
The estate was located near to the [[Bank of the Core Plaza]]. It contained thousands of offices for employees of the Praji family and was surrounded by a park that was large enough to land a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] on. The park was maintained by a group of [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] gardners.

==History==
The Estate was established during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], after the Prajii left their homeworld [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] and relocated to Coruscant. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Coruscant was [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|captured]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and the estate was destroyed when they [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the planet.
